item.title: Somewhere Quiet and Hopeful

turns.text: Make me an illustration that feels quiet and a little hopeful. You pick the scene and style. No words.

item.tests: Whether the agent turns a vague mood into a coherent illustration without demanding unnecessary creative decisions from the user.
must_haves: The deliverable is an illustration rather than a photograph.
The composition conveys quiet through visual restraint, stillness, or spaciousness rather than busy action.
A visible cue such as gentle light, growth, or an opening conveys some hope rather than unrelieved gloom.
The scene and palette form a coherent mood rather than a collection of unrelated elements.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: A quiet, gently hopeful illustration, poetic gouache and softly textured watercolor on warm ivory paper. An intimate view of a small apartment windowsill just after rain at dawn: a single young green plant with two fresh leaves growing in a humble terracotta pot, a slightly open pale curtain, tiny rain droplets on the window. Beyond the glass, a few muted blue-gray rooftops and a softly clearing sky; one delicate ray of warm apricot morning light falls across the leaves and sill. Restrained palette of misty slate blue, sage green, warm cream and pale peach. Beautiful simple shapes, tender hand-painted edges, subtle paper grain, generous negative space, understated editorial illustration. Stillness, resilience and the sense that tomorrow might be kind. No people, no dramatic effects, no clutter. Absolutely no words, text, letters, typography, numbers, signatures or watermarks.
